# Aurora Labs Nova

## Overview

The [Aurora Labs](./aurora-labs.md) Nova is a sensor device discussed within [home automation](./home-automation.md) and [homelab](./homelab.md) communities (such as the HomeLab [Sensors](./sensors.md) forum). It is notable for featuring cloud-free operation and utilizing [MeshSync](./meshsync.md) technology, appealing to users who prefer local control over subscription-based models.

## Key Details

- **Operation:** Completely cloud-free, utilizing MeshSync.
- **[Battery Life](./battery-life.md):** Aurora Labs claims a 2-year battery life with readings taken every 15 minutes. Teardown estimates suggest an expected lifespan of approximately 20 months under practical conditions.

## Related Entities

- **Aurora Labs:** The manufacturer of the Nova device.
- **[Sensenode](./sensenode.md):** A competing or alternative sensor option noted for being IP67 waterproof, though it features a subscription model.

## Related Concepts

- **MeshSync:** The local [networking](./networking.md)/synchronization protocol used by the Nova device to operate without cloud infrastructure.
- **Cloud-free Operation:** Local-only automation and sensor data handling that avoids external servers or subscriptions.

## Contradictions

&gt; **Contradiction:** Aurora Labs officially claims a 2-year battery life at 15-minute read intervals, whereas independent teardown and blog estimates suggest a slightly lower real-world expectation of around 20 months.
